findings: Left ventricular hypertrophy with volume overload pattern
Normal axis with lateral T flattening

echoTasks.find: Bicuspid valve with a raphe and an eccentric diastolic jet on colour in long axis
Mildly enlarged left ventricle with vigorous motion in the apical window
Diastolic jet on colour with slow deceleration on continuous wave Doppler

auscultation.added: Aortic ejection sound from the bicuspid valve
auscultation.murmur: Early diastolic decrescendo murmur grade 2 of 4 at the left sternal edge

exam.general: Fit 50 year old man, no distress, athletic build
exam.other: Mildly collapsing pulse, lungs clear, no oedema
exam.precordium: Mildly displaced apex beat, no thrill

history.a: Awareness of heartbeat on exertion for 6 months, exercise tolerance preserved
No chest pain, no syncope, no orthopnoea
Murmur known since teens, lost to follow up after moving cities
No hypertension, no diabetes, no drugs
IT professional, cycles to work, wants a surveillance plan
No family valve disease, father hypertensive

keyPoints: Enrol in 6 to 12 monthly surveillance with identical jet and chamber measurements
Set colour gain and scale identically each visit so jet comparison is valid
Counsel on endocarditis precautions and prompt reporting of tolerance change
Control systolic pressure gently to reduce regurgitant load
Refer to the heart team when dimensions or symptoms cross operative thresholds
management.model: Protocolised surveillance with identical Doppler settings, pressure control, and threshold based referral

sources: ASE guideline on valvular regurgitation, in own words
ESC guideline on valvular heart disease, in own words
stem: A 50 year old IT professional from Hyderabad with a murmur known since his teens reports awareness of his heartbeat on exertion. A grade 2 early diastolic murmur with an ejection sound is heard.
teaching: Moderate means orifice 0.10 to 0.29 sq cm with volume 30 to 59 ml
The sonographer fixes colour gain and scale so jets compare across visits
A raphe in systole plus an eccentric jet marks the bicuspid mechanism
Threshold based referral needs identical dimensions every time
title: Moderate bicuspid aortic regurgitation under surveillance
